podcast.body: The Village People initially objected to Donald Trump's campaign using "Macho Man" at rallies. This objection was part of a larger trend where numerous artists tried to prevent their music from being associated with political campaigns, often through cease and desist orders and lawsuits. "even the village people initially wanted Trump to stop using YMCA and Macho Man at Israelis."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
